 7 die of dengue, 1,596 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 452 this year 
 Published : 5 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 5 November 2026, 17:07
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least seven dengue patients died and 1,596 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, three each were reported in Dhaka and Chattogram divisions, and one in Khulna division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities, the country's dengue death toll this year has risen to 452, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 144,371.
 Currently, 5,839 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
